businessCases.question: 2026年9月已完成订单的销售额是多少？

expected.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(i.quantity*i.sale_price),2) FROM demo_sales_order o JOIN demo_sales_order_item i ON i.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.order_status='COMPLETED' AND o.order_date>='2026-09-01' AND o.order_date<'2026-10-01'

businessCases.question: 哪些商品当前库存低于安全库存？
按商品统计9月销售额，从高到低排列。
华东地区客户9月贡献了多少销售额？

expected.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(i.quantity*i.sale_price),2) FROM demo_sales_order o JOIN demo_sales_order_item i ON i.order_id=o.order_id JOIN demo_customer c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id WHERE o.order_status='COMPLETED' AND o.order_date>='2026-09-01' AND o.order_date<'2026-10-01' AND c.region_name='华东'
